Nora: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about GPU supply and autoscaler plans. Dropping notes + a few open questions.
Chen: Thanks — curious who owns the go/no-go for region-level failover?
Omar: Oncall lead + SRE coordinate. infra team executes routing flip and capacity configs.
Priya: We should codify thresholds. proposal: sustained reserved GPU > 92% for 3m AND queued requests growth > 15% over 10m.
Felix: Can we use a sliding-window so noisy spikes don't trigger failover?
Priya: Yes, the autoscaler uses a 3-minute exponential moving average; final trigger requires two consecutive windows.
Nora: Dedicated tenants often need stricter guarantees. What's the opt-out flag for auto failover?
Chen: config key: tenant_controls.allow_auto_region_failover (boolean). default=false for Dedicated, true for hosted.
Omar: Fallback sequencing we discussed: 1) reduced-gpu-profile (lower-power GPU), 2) degraded batching (increase batch window), 3) cpu-fallback for non-interactive workloads, 4) rate-limited passthrough if all else fails.
Felix: For CPU fallback, can we limit it to embeddings and background ops, not chat?
Priya: Yes — routing policy contains workload_class -> allowed_fallbacks list. chat is excluded unless explicitly enabled.
infra-bot: Dry-run scheduled: fallback-dryrun-2026-06-02T09:00Z on staging (eu-central). will simulate supply_signal=low.
Nora: How do we protect model quality when serving quantized/cpu variants?
Omar: Canarying: default 2% traffic for 15m with real-time quality hooks. abort conditions: latency increase > 20% OR top-k similarity drop > 10% vs baseline.
Felix: Who owns alerts for regression during canary?
Priya: evals-team owns quality checks, infra owns infra-health alerts. pager goes to oncall + evals lead.
Chen: Customer comms plan?
Nora: Draft: console banner + targeted email + auto ticket creation for affected accounts. legal-bot will review copy for regulated customers.
legal-bot: Will review draft and flag any PII-related language. ETA 48 hours.
Priya: Action items: Nora -> publish playbook PR (decision tree + comms template), Chen -> add tenant opt-out docs, Omar -> run dry-run and share logs, Felix -> add workload-class rules to routing config.
Omar: I'll start the staging dry-run and post results here.
Nora: Also request: add a small console widget: "supply risk" (green/amber/red) that combines supply_signal, queue_length, and upcoming scheduled maintenance. thoughts?
Felix: I can sketch the widget next week — will use supply_score = weighted(sum(supply_signal, queue_len_norm, maintenance_flag)).
Nora: Great. let's aim to rehearse failover as part of the next ops drill.
infra-bot: Dry-run started: fallback-dryrun-2026-06-02T09:00Z, simulated triggers fired, canary deployed, metrics streaming to #metrics-staging.
Chen: Thx everyone. Please link PRs back to this thread so we can close the loop. :thumbsup:
__notes: All-hands follow-up thread: playbook, dry-run, canary rules, tenant opt-out, comms and action items for GPU supply and autoscaler failover
